# Durable retry across an outage and a restart of the server executable.
# Request IDs bind one accepted task and survive restart. Graceful shutdown
# cancels and joins owned Local work before committing its terminal state.
# Request IDs are a Go extension; upstream has no client-chosen submission identity.
taskfile success.json success
taskfile hold.json hold

# Policy discovery must succeed before a submission path or hint is chosen.
# With no server, GetRetention is unavailable: no implicit fallback or hint.
# The supplied ID remains unchanged for the explicit retry after startup.
! skygo run -f success.json --request-id outage
stderr '^unavailable: '
! stderr 'request-id:'
! stderr 'request-domain:'
! stderr 'submit \('
! stdout .
env SKYGO_EXIT_CODE
stdout '^SKYGO_EXIT_CODE=1\n$'

server start
skygo --json run -f success.json --request-id outage --wait
stdout '"state": *"JOB_STATE_SUCCEEDED"'
job-id OUTAGE

# The data directory has one writer; a second server is refused.
! skygo server --listen 127.0.0.1:0 --data-dir $DATA
stderr '^server lifetime: state acquisition failed\n$'

skygo --json run -f hold.json --request-id hold
job-id HOLD
await-file ready
server stop
! stderr .
! skygo jobs get $HOLD
stderr '^unavailable: '
rm ready

server start
# Bindings survive the restart: the same request returns the same job, and
# the ID still refuses a different task.
skygo --json run -f success.json --request-id outage
stdout '"id": *"'$OUTAGE'"'
stdout '"state": *"JOB_STATE_SUCCEEDED"'
! skygo run -f hold.json --request-id outage
stderr 'already_exists'

# Graceful shutdown canceled and joined the owned Local workload before
# committing its terminal state. Restart replays it without another execution.
! skygo --json run -f hold.json --request-id hold --wait
stdout '"id": *"'$HOLD'"'
stdout '"state": *"JOB_STATE_CANCELED"'
stdout '"reason": *"canceled by operator"'
skygo jobs logs $HOLD
stdout '^holding\n$'
! exists ready
skygo jobs list
stdout '^ID +TARGET +STATE\n'$OUTAGE' +local +succeeded\n'$HOLD' +local +canceled\n$'

server stop
! stdout .
! stderr .
